#      Nuevo proyecto, aqui quiero mostrar los análisis de riqueza y diversidad por dias

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)

# Cargar los datos
class <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/combined_data_only_IPL.csv", 
                    sep = ",", header = TRUE)

# Filtrar muestras Surface y Bottom
class_surface <- class %>% filter(grepl("^Surface", X))
class_bottom  <- class %>% filter(grepl("^Bottom", X))
```


#--------------------------------------------
#        EMPECEMOS CON SURFACE
#--------------------------------------------

# habia algo mal en el ressultado anterior pienso que estaba tomando solo un valor de cada dia y no un promedio de los dias repetidos, vamos a corregirlo

```{r}
# Cargar paquetes
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Filtrar Surface y extraer día real de la columna X
class_surface <- class %>%
  filter(grepl("^Surface", X)) %>%
  mutate(Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", X)))

# Calcular índices por muestra
calc_indices <- function(x) {
  x <- round(x)
  est <- estimateR(x)
  return(data.frame(Chao1 = est["S.chao1"], ACE = est["S.ACE"]))
}

indices_df <- class_surface %>%
  select(X, Day, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(temp = list(calc_indices(c_across(where(is.numeric))))) %>%
  unnest(temp)

# Calcular media y error estándar por día real y métrica
summary_df <- indices_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Chao1", "ACE"), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Day, Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Value),
    SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Colores más suaves del espectro RdBu
palette_colors <- brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(2, 10)]  # azul medio y rojo medio # [c(3, 9)] alternative

# Etiquetas personalizadas
ticks <- c(10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 38, 50)
labels <- paste0("Day-", ticks)

# Graficar
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Day, y = Mean, color = Metric, group = Metric)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(size = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), width = 1.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Chao1 and ACE indices", color = "Metric") +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(palette_colors, c("ACE", "Chao1"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = ticks, labels = labels) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)  # Rotar etiquetas del eje X
  )
```

```{r}
# Separar los datos para el gráfico de doble eje Y
data_lipidos <- combined_data %>% filter(Tipo == "Lipidos")
data_16s <- combined_data %>% filter(Tipo == "16S")

# Para el gráfico con doble eje Y necesitamos calcular un factor de escala
max_lipidos <- max(data_lipidos$Mean)
max_16s <- max(data_16s$Mean)
scale_factor <- max_lipidos / max_16s

# Colores personalizados para diferentes combinaciones
my_colors <- c(
  "Lipidos-ACE" = "#9E3C3C",          # rojo oscuro para IPL-ACE
  "Lipidos-Chao1" = "#F08080",        # rojo claro para IPL-Chao1
  "16S-ACE" = "#084594",              # azul oscuro para 16S-ACE
  "16S-Chao1" = "#3182BD"             # azul claro para 16S-Chao1
)

# Crear el gráfico combinado con doble eje Y
p1 <- ggplot() +
  # Datos de IPL (eje Y izquierdo)
  geom_point(data = data_lipidos, aes(x = Day, y = Mean, color = Combo, shape = Metric), size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = data_lipidos, aes(x = Day, y = Mean, color = Combo, group = Combo), size = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(data = data_lipidos, aes(x = Day, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE, color = Combo), width = 1.2) +
  
  # Datos de 16S (escalados para el eje Y izquierdo)
  geom_point(data = data_16s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean * scale_factor, color = Combo, shape = Metric), size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = data_16s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean * scale_factor, color = Combo, group = Combo), size = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(data = data_16s, aes(x = Day, ymin = (Mean - SE) * scale_factor, 
                                     ymax = (Mean + SE) * scale_factor, color = Combo), width = 1.2) +
  
  # Eje Y secundario para los datos 16S
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "IPL - Richness (Chao1 & ACE)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~./scale_factor, name = "16S rRNA - Richness (Chao1 & ACE)")
  ) +
  
  # Estilo
  scale_color_manual(
    values = my_colors,
    labels = c(
      "Lipidos-ACE" = "IPL - ACE",
      "Lipidos-Chao1" = "IPL - Chao1",
      "16S-ACE" = "16S rRNA - ACE",
      "16S-Chao1" = "16S rRNA - Chao1"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("ACE" = 16, "Chao1" = 17)) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Day") +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "#9E3C3C", size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#084594", size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "#9E3C3C"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "#084594")
  ) +
  guides(shape = "none")  # remover la guía de forma

p1
```

# Ahora Hagamos esto para Simpson

# Ahora analisis de diversidad con Simpson y Shannon
# Primero Surface
#Lipidos
```{r}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Asegurarse de tener columna 'Day'
class_surface <- class_surface %>%
  mutate(Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", X)))

# Calcular Shannon y Simpson por muestra
diversity_df <- class_surface %>%
  select(X, Day, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Shannon = diversity(c_across(where(is.numeric)), index = "shannon"),
    Simpson = diversity(c_across(where(is.numeric)), index = "simpson")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Pasar a formato largo y calcular media y error estándar por día y métrica
summary_diversity <- diversity_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Shannon", "Simpson"), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Day, Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Value),
    SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Crear una columna escalada solo para graficar
summary_diversity_scaled <- summary_diversity %>%
  mutate(
    DisplayValue = ifelse(Metric == "Simpson", Mean * 4, Mean),
    SE_scaled = ifelse(Metric == "Simpson", SE * 4, SE)
  )
```

```{r}
# Elegir colores adecuados (más sobrios y contrastantes)
div_colors <- c("Shannon" = "#1f77b4", "Simpson" = "#d62728")  # Azul y rojo sobrio

ggplot(summary_diversity_scaled, aes(x = Day, y = DisplayValue, color = Metric, group = Metric)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(size = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = DisplayValue - SE_scaled, ymax = DisplayValue + SE_scaled), width = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = div_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = ticks, labels = labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Shannon Index",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 4, name = "Simpson Index")  # Mostrar escala original de Simpson
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Day", color = "Metric") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```

```{r}
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#           COMBINAMOS SURFACE LIPIDOS Y 16S PARA INDICES DE DIVERSIDAD
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Agregar columna de tipo de dato para ambos datasets
summary_div_lipidos <- summary_diversity %>% 
  mutate(Tipo = "Lipidos")

summary_div_16s <- summary_div_surface %>% 
  mutate(Tipo = "16S")

# Combinar ambos datasets
combined_diversity <- bind_rows(summary_div_lipidos, summary_div_16s)

# Crear la combinación de tipo de dato y métrica
combined_diversity <- combined_diversity %>%
  mutate(Combo = paste(Tipo, Metric, sep = "-"))

# Colores personalizados para las diferentes combinaciones
# Lípidos: tonos rojos, 16S: tonos azules
my_div_colors <- c(
  "Lipidos-Shannon" = "#8C510A",   # marrón oscuro para IPL-Shannon
  "Lipidos-Simpson" = "#D8B365",   # marrón claro para IPL-Simpson
  "16S-Shannon" = "#01665E",       # verde esmeralda oscuro para 16S-Shannon
  "16S-Simpson" = "#5AB4AC"        # verde agua para 16S-Simpson
)

# Para crear el gráfico con doble eje Y necesitamos escalar
# Primero, separamos los datos

# Para Shannon indices
shannon_data <- combined_diversity %>% 
  filter(Metric == "Shannon")

# Para Simpson indices
simpson_data <- combined_diversity %>% 
  filter(Metric == "Simpson")

# Calcular factores de escala para Simpson
# Queremos que Shannon esté en el eje principal, Simpson en el secundario
scale_factor_simpson <- max(shannon_data$Mean) / max(simpson_data$Mean)

# Graficar
p_diversity_surface <- ggplot() +
  # Shannon indices (todos los datos)
  geom_point(data = shannon_data, aes(x = Day, y = Mean, color = Combo), size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = shannon_data, aes(x = Day, y = Mean, color = Combo, group = Combo), size = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(data = shannon_data, aes(x = Day, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE, color = Combo), width = 1.2) +
  
  # Simpson indices (escalados para mostrarse en el gráfico)
  geom_point(data = simpson_data, aes(x = Day, y = Mean * scale_factor_simpson, color = Combo), size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = simpson_data, aes(x = Day, y = Mean * scale_factor_simpson, color = Combo, group = Combo), size = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(data = simpson_data, aes(x = Day, ymin = (Mean - SE) * scale_factor_simpson, 
                                         ymax = (Mean + SE) * scale_factor_simpson, color = Combo), width = 1.2) +
  
  # Ejes Y dobles
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Shannon Index",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~./scale_factor_simpson, name = "Simpson Index")
  ) +
  
  # Colores y estilo
  scale_color_manual(
    values = my_div_colors,
    labels = c(
      "Lipidos-Shannon" = "IPL - Shannon",
      "Lipidos-Simpson" = "IPL - Simpson",
      "16S-Shannon" = "16S rRNA - Shannon",
      "16S-Simpson" = "16S rRNA - Simpson"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Day", title = "Surface - Diversity Indices Comparison") +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
```

# nueva diversdad
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## ---- Cargar datos ----
rates <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/Sebastian_Data/Rates.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE,
                     na.strings = c("NA", "NaN", "NAN", ""))

## Una tasa de fijación de N no puede ser negativa en este contexto oceanográfico:
## los valores negativos son ruido de la medición cerca de cero. Se truncan a
## nivel de réplica individual (antes de promediar), para que la media y el SE
## ya reflejen la corrección.
rates <- rates %>% mutate(N_Fix = pmax(N_Fix, 0, na.rm = FALSE))

## ---- Resumen (media +/- SE) por Day y Depth para cada variable ----
summarise_rate <- function(df, depth_name, value_col) {
  df %>%
    filter(Depth == depth_name, !is.na(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(.data[[value_col]]),
              SE = sd(.data[[value_col]]) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop")
}

nfix_surface    <- summarise_rate(rates, "Surface",    "N_Fix")
nfix_subsurface <- summarise_rate(rates, "Subsurface", "N_Fix")
denit_subsurface <- summarise_rate(rates, "Subsurface", "denitri_rate")
anammox_subsurface <- summarise_rate(rates, "Subsurface", "anammox_rate")

## =====================================================================
##  FASES (igual que en las figuras anteriores)
## =====================================================================
phase_df <- data.frame(
  Phase = factor(c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),
                 levels = c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV")),
  xmin  = c(0.5, 11.5, 19.5, 37.5),
  xmax  = c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5, 50.5)
)
phase_colors <- c("Phase I" = "#8C1D40", "Phase II" = "#F2A93B",
                   "Phase III" = "#AEE1C8", "Phase IV" = "#3D7EB5")
phase_vlines <- c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5)
x_limits <- c(0, 51)

make_phase_strip <- function() {
  ggplot(phase_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = Phase),
              color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = 0.5, label = Phase),
              size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phase_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 0, 5.5))
}

process_colors <- c("Denitrification rate" = "#D7191C",
                     "Anammox rate"        = "#2166AC",
                     "N-Fixation rate"     = "#1B7837")

## =====================================================================
##  PANEL E: Surface -> solo N-Fixation (unico proceso medido en Surface)
## =====================================================================
make_surface_rates_plot <- function() {
  ggplot(nfix_surface, aes(x = Day, y = Mean)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phase_vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(color = process_colors[["N-Fixation rate"]], linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(color = process_colors[["N-Fixation rate"]], size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                  color = process_colors[["N-Fixation rate"]], width = 0.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = x_limits) +
    labs(x = "Day", y = expression("N-Fixation rate (nmol N"[2]*" L"^-1*" h"^-1*")"),
         title = "Surface") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

## =====================================================================
##  PANEL F: Subsurface -> Denitrification + Anammox + N-Fixation
## =====================================================================
make_subsurface_rates_plot <- function() {

  denit_range <- range(c(denit_subsurface$Mean - denit_subsurface$SE,
                          denit_subsurface$Mean + denit_subsurface$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  other_vals  <- c(anammox_subsurface$Mean - anammox_subsurface$SE,
                    anammox_subsurface$Mean + anammox_subsurface$SE,
                    nfix_subsurface$Mean - nfix_subsurface$SE,
                    nfix_subsurface$Mean + nfix_subsurface$SE)
  other_range <- range(other_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

  b <- diff(denit_range) / diff(other_range)
  a <- denit_range[1] - b * other_range[1]

  anammox_s <- anammox_subsurface %>% mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)
  nfix_s    <- nfix_subsurface    %>% mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)
  denit_s   <- denit_subsurface   %>% mutate(Mean_s = Mean, SE_s = SE)

  ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phase_vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +

    geom_line(data = denit_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "Denitrification rate"), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = denit_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "Denitrification rate"), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = denit_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s,
                                       color = "Denitrification rate"), width = 0.8) +

    geom_line(data = anammox_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "Anammox rate"), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = anammox_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "Anammox rate"), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = anammox_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s,
                                         color = "Anammox rate"), width = 0.8) +

    geom_line(data = nfix_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "N-Fixation rate"), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = nfix_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "N-Fixation rate"), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = nfix_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s,
                                      color = "N-Fixation rate"), width = 0.8) +

    scale_color_manual(name = "Nitrogen Process", values = process_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = x_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = expression("Denitrification rate (nmol N"[2]*" L"^-1*" h"^-1*")"),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a) / b,
                           name = expression("Anammox & N-Fix rates (nmol N"[2]*" L"^-1*" h"^-1*")"))
    ) +
    labs(x = "Day", title = "Subsurface") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

p_E_surface_rates    <- make_phase_strip() / make_surface_rates_plot()    + plot_layout(heights = c(0.07, 1))
p_F_subsurface_rates <- make_phase_strip() / make_subsurface_rates_plot() + plot_layout(heights = c(0.07, 1))

combined_rates <- (p_E_surface_rates | p_F_subsurface_rates) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))

combined_rates
```

# Chao1 indice de Riqueza

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## ---- Cargar datos ----
ipl_data <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/combined_data_only_IPL.csv",
                        sep = ",", header = TRUE)
bac_data <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/merged_data_clean_M5_M6_ORDER_phases.csv",
                        sep = ",", header = TRUE)

calc_chao1 <- function(x) {
  x <- round(x)
  est <- estimateR(x)
  data.frame(Chao1 = est["S.chao1"])
}

get_summary <- function(df, pattern, id_col) {
  df %>%
    filter(grepl(pattern, .data[[id_col]])) %>%
    mutate(Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", .data[[id_col]]))) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), Day, where(is.numeric)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(temp = list(calc_chao1(c_across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Day$"))))) %>%
    unnest(temp) %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(Chao1), SE = sd(Chao1) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
}

ipl_surface <- get_summary(ipl_data, "^Surface", "X") %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
ipl_bottom  <- get_summary(ipl_data, "^Bottom",  "X") %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
bac_surface <- get_summary(bac_data, "^Surface", "ID") %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")
bac_bottom  <- get_summary(bac_data, "^Bottom",  "ID") %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")

## ---- Constructor de gráfico con doble eje ----
make_dual_plot <- function(ipl_df, bac_df, layer_name) {

  ipl_range <- range(c(ipl_df$Mean - ipl_df$SE, ipl_df$Mean + ipl_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  bac_range <- range(c(bac_df$Mean - bac_df$SE, bac_df$Mean + bac_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)

  b <- diff(ipl_range) / diff(bac_range)
  a <- ipl_range[1] - b * bac_range[1]

  bac_df_scaled <- bac_df %>%
    mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)

  plot_df <- bind_rows(
    ipl_df %>% mutate(Mean_s = Mean, SE_s = SE),
    bac_df_scaled
  ) %>%
    mutate(DataType = factor(DataType, levels = c("Lipids (IPL)", "16S rRNA")))

  all_days <- sort(unique(plot_df$Day))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = DataType, group = DataType)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s), width = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Lipids (IPL)" = "#4393C3", "16S rRNA" = "#D6604D")) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Chao1 index (Lipids, IPL)",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a) / b, name = "Chao1 index (16S rRNA)")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_days, labels = paste0("Day-", all_days)) +
    labs(x = "Day", color = "Data type", title = layer_name) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "#4393C3"),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "#4393C3"),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#D6604D"),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "#D6604D"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

p_A <- make_dual_plot(ipl_surface, bac_surface, "Surface")
p_B <- make_dual_plot(ipl_bottom,  bac_bottom,  "Subsurface")

combined <- (p_A + p_B) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +

    legend.position = "top",

  )
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## ---- Cargar datos ----
ipl_data <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/combined_data_only_IPL.csv",
                        sep = ",", header = TRUE)
bac_data <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/merged_data_clean_M5_M6_ORDER_phases.csv",
                        sep = ",", header = TRUE)

## ---- Función: Shannon medio +/- SE por día y capa ----
get_shannon_summary <- function(df, pattern, id_col) {
  df %>%
    filter(grepl(pattern, .data[[id_col]])) %>%
    mutate(Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", .data[[id_col]]))) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), Day, where(is.numeric)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(Shannon = diversity(c_across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Day$")), index = "shannon")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(Shannon), SE = sd(Shannon) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
}

ipl_surface <- get_shannon_summary(ipl_data, "^Surface", "X") %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
ipl_bottom  <- get_shannon_summary(ipl_data, "^Bottom",  "X") %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")

bac_bottom  <- get_shannon_summary(bac_data, "^Bottom",  "ID") %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")

## ---- Constructor de gráfico con doble eje (misma lógica que Chao1) ----
make_dual_plot_shannon <- function(ipl_df, bac_df, layer_name) {

  ipl_range <- range(c(ipl_df$Mean - ipl_df$SE, ipl_df$Mean + ipl_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  bac_range <- range(c(bac_df$Mean - bac_df$SE, bac_df$Mean + bac_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)

  b <- diff(ipl_range) / diff(bac_range)
  a <- ipl_range[1] - b * bac_range[1]

  bac_df_scaled <- bac_df %>%
    mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)

  plot_df <- bind_rows(
    ipl_df %>% mutate(Mean_s = Mean, SE_s = SE),
    bac_df_scaled
  ) %>%
    mutate(DataType = factor(DataType, levels = c("Lipids (IPL)", "16S rRNA")))

  all_days <- sort(unique(plot_df$Day))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = DataType, group = DataType)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s), width = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Lipids (IPL)" = "#4393C3", "16S rRNA" = "#D6604D")) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Shannon index (Lipids, IPL)",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a) / b, name = "Shannon index (16S rRNA)")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_days, labels = paste0("Day-", all_days)) +
    labs(x = "Day", color = "Data type", title = layer_name) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "#4393C3"),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "#4393C3"),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#D6604D"),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "#D6604D"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## ---- Cargar datos ----
ipl_data <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/combined_data_only_IPL.csv",
                        sep = ",", header = TRUE)
bac_data <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/merged_data_clean_M5_M6_ORDER_phases.csv",
                        sep = ",", header = TRUE)

## ---- Función genérica: resumen (media +/- SE) por día y capa para un índice dado ----
get_index_summary <- function(df, pattern, id_col, index_fun) {
  df %>%
    filter(grepl(pattern, .data[[id_col]])) %>%
    mutate(Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", .data[[id_col]]))) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), Day, where(is.numeric)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(Value = index_fun(c_across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Day$")))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(Value), SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
}

chao1_fun   <- function(x) estimateR(round(x))["S.chao1"]
shannon_fun <- function(x) diversity(x, index = "shannon")

## ---- Riqueza (Chao1) ----
rich_ipl_surface <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Surface", "X",  chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
rich_ipl_bottom  <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Bottom",  "X",  chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
rich_bac_surface <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Surface", "ID", chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")
rich_bac_bottom  <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Bottom",  "ID", chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")

## ---- Diversidad (Shannon) ----
div_ipl_surface <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Surface", "X",  shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
div_ipl_bottom  <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Bottom",  "X",  shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
div_bac_surface <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Surface", "ID", shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")
div_bac_bottom  <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Bottom",  "ID", shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")

## ---- Paletas: una familia de colores para riqueza, otra para diversidad ----
palette_richness  <- c("Lipids (IPL)" = "#4393C3", "16S rRNA" = "#D6604D")  # azul / rojo
palette_diversity <- c("Lipids (IPL)" = "#2CA25F", "16S rRNA" = "#88419D")  # verde / morado

## ---- Constructor de gráfico con doble eje (recibe la paleta como argumento) ----
make_dual_plot <- function(ipl_df, bac_df, layer_name, index_name, colors) {

  ipl_range <- range(c(ipl_df$Mean - ipl_df$SE, ipl_df$Mean + ipl_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  bac_range <- range(c(bac_df$Mean - bac_df$SE, bac_df$Mean + bac_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)

  b <- diff(ipl_range) / diff(bac_range)
  a <- ipl_range[1] - b * bac_range[1]

  bac_df_scaled <- bac_df %>%
    mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)

  plot_df <- bind_rows(
    ipl_df %>% mutate(Mean_s = Mean, SE_s = SE),
    bac_df_scaled
  ) %>%
    mutate(DataType = factor(DataType, levels = c("Lipids (IPL)", "16S rRNA")))

  all_days <- sort(unique(plot_df$Day))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = DataType, group = DataType)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s), width = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = paste0(index_name, " index (Lipids, IPL)"),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a) / b, name = paste0(index_name, " index (16S rRNA)"))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_days, labels = paste0("Day-", all_days)) +
    labs(x = "Day", color = "Data type", title = layer_name) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = colors[["Lipids (IPL)"]]),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = colors[["Lipids (IPL)"]]),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = colors[["16S rRNA"]]),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = colors[["16S rRNA"]]),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

## ---- Panel A/B: Riqueza (Chao1) - paleta azul/rojo ----
p_A_rich <- make_dual_plot(rich_ipl_surface, rich_bac_surface, "Surface",    "Chao1", palette_richness)
p_B_rich <- make_dual_plot(rich_ipl_bottom,  rich_bac_bottom,  "Subsurface", "Chao1", palette_richness)

## ---- Panel C/D: Diversidad (Shannon) - paleta verde/morado ----
p_C_div <- make_dual_plot(div_ipl_surface, div_bac_surface, "Surface",    "Shannon", palette_diversity)
p_D_div <- make_dual_plot(div_ipl_bottom,  div_bac_bottom,  "Subsurface", "Shannon", palette_diversity)

## ---- Unir todo: A,B arriba (riqueza) / C,D abajo (diversidad) ----
## Nota: como cada fila usa una paleta distinta, ya no se puede usar una sola
## leyenda "collect" (patchwork la fusionaría de forma incorrecta). Cada fila
## conserva su propia leyenda arriba.
combined_full <- (p_A_rich + p_B_rich) / (p_C_div + p_D_div) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))

combined_full
```

```{r}
## ---- Función genérica: resumen (media +/- SE) por día y capa para un índice dado ----
get_index_summary <- function(df, pattern, id_col, index_fun) {
  df %>%
    filter(grepl(pattern, .data[[id_col]])) %>%
    mutate(Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", .data[[id_col]]))) %>%

chao1_fun   <- function(x) estimateR(round(x))["S.chao1"]
shannon_fun <- function(x) diversity(x, index = "shannon")

## =====================================================================

phase_df <- data.frame(
  Phase = factor(c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),

## ---- Franja superior de fases (se coloca encima de cada gráfico) ----
make_phase_strip <- function() {
  ggplot(phase_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = Phase),
              color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +

              size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +

          plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 0, 5.5))

## ---- Constructor de gráfico principal con doble eje + líneas de fase ----
make_dual_plot <- function(ipl_df, bac_df, layer_name, index_name, colors) {

  ipl_range <- range(c(ipl_df$Mean - ipl_df$SE, ipl_df$Mean + ipl_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  bac_range <- range(c(bac_df$Mean - bac_df$SE, bac_df$Mean + bac_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)

  b <- diff(ipl_range) / diff(bac_range)
  a <- ipl_range[1] - b * bac_range[1]

  bac_df_scaled <- bac_df %>%
    mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)

  plot_df <- bind_rows(
    ipl_df %>% mutate(Mean_s = Mean, SE_s = SE),
    bac_df_scaled
  ) %>%
    mutate(DataType = factor(DataType, levels = c("Lipids (IPL)", "16S rRNA")))

  all_days <- sort(unique(plot_df$Day))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = DataType, group = DataType)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phase_vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s), width = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = paste0(index_name, " index (Lipids, IPL)"),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a) / b, name = paste0(index_name, " index (16S rRNA)"))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_days, labels = paste0("Day-", all_days), limits = x_limits) +
    labs(x = "Day", color = "Data type", title = layer_name) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = colors[["Lipids (IPL)"]]),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = colors[["Lipids (IPL)"]]),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = colors[["16S rRNA"]]),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = colors[["16S rRNA"]]),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

## ---- Combina franja de fases + gráfico principal en un solo bloque ----
make_panel_with_phases <- function(ipl_df, bac_df, layer_name, index_name, colors) {
  strip <- make_phase_strip()
  main  <- make_dual_plot(ipl_df, bac_df, layer_name, index_name, colors)
  strip / main + plot_layout(heights = c(0.07, 1))
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## ---- Cargar datos ----
rates <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/Sebastian_Data/Rates.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE,
                     na.strings = c("NA", "NaN", "NAN", ""))

## Una tasa de fijación de N no puede ser negativa en este contexto oceanográfico:
## los valores negativos son ruido de la medición cerca de cero. Se truncan a
## nivel de réplica individual (antes de promediar), para que la media y el SE
## ya reflejen la corrección.
rates <- rates %>% mutate(N_Fix = pmax(N_Fix, 0, na.rm = FALSE))

## ---- Resumen (media +/- SE) por Day y Depth para cada variable ----
summarise_rate <- function(df, depth_name, value_col) {
  df %>%
    filter(Depth == depth_name, !is.na(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(.data[[value_col]]),
              SE = sd(.data[[value_col]]) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop")
}

nfix_surface    <- summarise_rate(rates, "Surface",    "N_Fix")
nfix_subsurface <- summarise_rate(rates, "Subsurface", "N_Fix")
denit_subsurface <- summarise_rate(rates, "Subsurface", "denitri_rate")
anammox_subsurface <- summarise_rate(rates, "Subsurface", "anammox_rate")

## =====================================================================
##  FASES (igual que en las figuras anteriores)
## =====================================================================
phase_df <- data.frame(
  Phase = factor(c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),
                 levels = c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV")),
  xmin  = c(0.5, 11.5, 19.5, 37.5),
  xmax  = c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5, 50.5)
)
phase_colors <- c("Phase I" = "#8C1D40", "Phase II" = "#F2A93B",
                   "Phase III" = "#AEE1C8", "Phase IV" = "#3D7EB5")
phase_vlines <- c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5)
x_limits <- c(0, 51)

make_phase_strip <- function() {
  ggplot(phase_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = Phase),
              color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = 0.5, label = Phase),
              size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phase_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 0, 5.5))
}

process_colors <- c("Denitrification rate" = "#D7191C",
                     "Anammox rate"        = "#2166AC",
                     "N-Fixation rate"     = "#1B7837")

## =====================================================================
##  PANEL E: Surface -> solo N-Fixation (unico proceso medido en Surface)
## =====================================================================
make_surface_rates_plot <- function() {
  ggplot(nfix_surface, aes(x = Day, y = Mean)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phase_vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(color = process_colors[["N-Fixation rate"]], linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(color = process_colors[["N-Fixation rate"]], size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                  color = process_colors[["N-Fixation rate"]], width = 0.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = x_limits) +
    labs(x = "Day", y = expression("N-Fixation rate (nmol N"[2]*" L"^-1*" h"^-1*")"),
         title = "Surface") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

## =====================================================================
##  PANEL F: Subsurface -> Denitrification + Anammox + N-Fixation
## =====================================================================
make_subsurface_rates_plot <- function() {

  denit_range <- range(c(denit_subsurface$Mean - denit_subsurface$SE,
                          denit_subsurface$Mean + denit_subsurface$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  other_vals  <- c(anammox_subsurface$Mean - anammox_subsurface$SE,
                    anammox_subsurface$Mean + anammox_subsurface$SE,
                    nfix_subsurface$Mean - nfix_subsurface$SE,
                    nfix_subsurface$Mean + nfix_subsurface$SE)
  other_range <- range(other_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

  b <- diff(denit_range) / diff(other_range)
  a <- denit_range[1] - b * other_range[1]

  anammox_s <- anammox_subsurface %>% mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)
  nfix_s    <- nfix_subsurface    %>% mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)
  denit_s   <- denit_subsurface   %>% mutate(Mean_s = Mean, SE_s = SE)

  ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phase_vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +

    geom_line(data = denit_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "Denitrification rate"), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = denit_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "Denitrification rate"), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = denit_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s,
                                       color = "Denitrification rate"), width = 0.8) +

    geom_line(data = anammox_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "Anammox rate"), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = anammox_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "Anammox rate"), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = anammox_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s,
                                         color = "Anammox rate"), width = 0.8) +

    geom_line(data = nfix_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "N-Fixation rate"), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = nfix_s, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = "N-Fixation rate"), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = nfix_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s,
                                      color = "N-Fixation rate"), width = 0.8) +

    scale_color_manual(name = "Nitrogen Process", values = process_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = x_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = expression("Denitrification rate (nmol N"[2]*" L"^-1*" h"^-1*")"),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a) / b,
                           name = expression("Anammox & N-Fix rates (nmol N"[2]*" L"^-1*" h"^-1*")"))
    ) +
    labs(x = "Day", title = "Subsurface") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

p_E_surface_rates    <- make_phase_strip() / make_surface_rates_plot()    + plot_layout(heights = c(0.07, 1))
p_F_subsurface_rates <- make_phase_strip() / make_subsurface_rates_plot() + plot_layout(heights = c(0.07, 1))

combined_rates <- (p_E_surface_rates | p_F_subsurface_rates) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))

combined_rates
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## =====================================================================
##  CARGAR DATOS
## =====================================================================
ipl_data  <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/combined_data_only_IPL.csv",
                         sep = ",", header = TRUE)
bac_data  <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/merged_data_clean_M5_M6_ORDER_phases.csv",
                         sep = ",", header = TRUE)
rates     <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/Sebastian_Data/Rates.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE,
                         na.strings = c("NA", "NaN", "NAN", ""))
rates <- rates %>% mutate(N_Fix = pmax(N_Fix, 0, na.rm = FALSE))

## =====================================================================
##  FASES (definición única, reutilizada por todo)
## =====================================================================
phase_df <- data.frame(
  Phase = factor(c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),
                 levels = c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV")),
  xmin  = c(0.5, 11.5, 19.5, 37.5),
  xmax  = c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5, 50.5)
)
phase_colors <- c("Phase I" = "#8C1D40", "Phase II" = "#F2A93B",
                   "Phase III" = "#AEE1C8", "Phase IV" = "#3D7EB5")
phase_vlines <- c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5)
x_limits <- c(0, 51)

make_phase_strip <- function(layer_name) {
  ggplot(phase_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = Phase),
              color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = 0.5, label = Phase),
              size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phase_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = layer_name) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 0, 5.5),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
}

## =====================================================================
##  RIQUEZA (Chao1) y DIVERSIDAD (Shannon) - IPL vs 16S
## =====================================================================
get_index_summary <- function(df, pattern, id_col, index_fun) {
  df %>%
    filter(grepl(pattern, .data[[id_col]])) %>%
    mutate(Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", .data[[id_col]]))) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), Day, where(is.numeric)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(Value = index_fun(c_across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Day$")))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(Value), SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
}
chao1_fun   <- function(x) estimateR(round(x))["S.chao1"]
shannon_fun <- function(x) diversity(x, index = "shannon")

rich_ipl_surface <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Surface", "X",  chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
rich_ipl_bottom  <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Bottom",  "X",  chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
rich_bac_surface <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Surface", "ID", chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")
rich_bac_bottom  <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Bottom",  "ID", chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")

div_ipl_surface <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Surface", "X",  shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
div_ipl_bottom  <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Bottom",  "X",  shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
div_bac_surface <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Surface", "ID", shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")
div_bac_bottom  <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Bottom",  "ID", shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")

palette_richness  <- c("Lipids (IPL)" = "#4393C3", "16S rRNA" = "#D6604D")
palette_diversity <- c("Lipids (IPL)" = "#2CA25F", "16S rRNA" = "#88419D")

## ---- Constructor de gráfico principal (SIN franja de fases; solo líneas discontinuas) ----
make_dual_plot <- function(ipl_df, bac_df, index_name, colors) {

  ipl_range <- range(c(ipl_df$Mean - ipl_df$SE, ipl_df$Mean + ipl_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  bac_range <- range(c(bac_df$Mean - bac_df$SE, bac_df$Mean + bac_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  b <- diff(ipl_range) / diff(bac_range)
  a <- ipl_range[1] - b * bac_range[1]

  bac_df_scaled <- bac_df %>% mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)
  plot_df <- bind_rows(ipl_df %>% mutate(Mean_s = Mean, SE_s = SE), bac_df_scaled) %>%
    mutate(DataType = factor(DataType, levels = c("Lipids (IPL)", "16S rRNA")))

  all_days <- sort(unique(plot_df$Day))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = DataType, group = DataType)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phase_vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s), width = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = paste0(index_name, " index (Lipids, IPL)"),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a) / b, name = paste0(index_name, " index (16S rRNA)"))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_days, labels = paste0("Day-", all_days), limits = x_limits) +
    labs(x = "Day", color = "Data type") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = colors[["Lipids (IPL)"]]),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = colors[["Lipids (IPL)"]]),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = colors[["16S rRNA"]]),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = colors[["16S rRNA"]]),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

p_rich_surface <- make_dual_plot(rich_ipl_surface, rich_bac_surface, "Chao1",   palette_richness)
p_rich_bottom  <- make_dual_plot(rich_ipl_bottom,  rich_bac_bottom,  "Chao1",   palette_richness)
p_div_surface  <- make_dual_plot(div_ipl_surface,  div_bac_surface,  "Shannon", palette_diversity)
p_div_bottom   <- make_dual_plot(div_ipl_bottom,   div_bac_bottom,  "Shannon", palette_diversity)

summarise_rate <- function(df, depth_name, value_col) {
  df %>%
    filter(Depth == depth_name, !is.na(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(.data[[value_col]]), SE = sd(.data[[value_col]]) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
}
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## =====================================================================
##  1) hzo / nirS  (Kai_qPCRs_amx_nirS.xlsx)
## =====================================================================
kai_raw <- read_excel("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/genes_data/Kai_qPCRs_amx_nirS.xlsx", sheet = 1)

kai_clean <- kai_raw %>%
  rename(SampleID = `Sample ID`, hzo = `hzo [copies/mL]`, nirS = `nirs [copies/mL]`, Day = Day) %>%
  mutate(SampleID = str_trim(SampleID)) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(SampleID, "^PAC"), !str_detect(SampleID, "^DW")) %>%
  mutate(
    Mesocosm = as.numeric(str_extract(SampleID, "(?<=M-)\\d+")),
    Layer = ifelse(str_detect(SampleID, "Surf"), "Surface", "Subsurface")
  ) %>%
  filter(Mesocosm %in% 5:8)

genes_ab <- kai_clean %>%
  select(Day, Layer, hzo, nirS) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(hzo, nirS), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Day, Layer, Gene) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Value), SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

## =====================================================================
##  2) nifH P8 / CR  (Susi_qPCR_data.xlsx, hoja Surf_Bott)
## =====================================================================
susi_raw <- read_excel("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/genes_data/Susi_qPCR_data.xlsx", sheet = "Surf_Bott")

measured_days <- c(2, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 24, 28, 32, 44, 48)

## columnas tipo "P8 M5 S", "CR M6 B", etc. Extraemos Gene / Mesocosm / Layer del nombre.
col_info <- tibble(col = names(susi_raw)) %>%
  filter(str_detect(col, "^(P8|CR) M\\d+ (S|B)\\s*$")) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = str_extract(col, "^(P8|CR)"),
    Mesocosm = as.numeric(str_extract(col, "(?<=M)\\d+")),
    Layer = ifelse(str_detect(col, " S\\s*$"), "Surface", "Subsurface")
  ) %>%
  filter(Mesocosm %in% 5:8)

nifH_long <- susi_raw %>%
  filter(day %in% measured_days) %>%
  select(Day = day, all_of(col_info$col)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Day, names_to = "col", values_to = "Value") %>%
  left_join(col_info, by = "col") %>%
  select(Day, Layer, Gene, Value)

genes_nifH <- nifH_long %>%
  group_by(Day, Layer, Gene) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), SE = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

## =====================================================================
##  FASES (misma definición usada en toda la figura)
## =====================================================================
phase_df <- data.frame(
  Phase = factor(c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),
                 levels = c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV")),
  xmin  = c(0.5, 11.5, 19.5, 37.5),
  xmax  = c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5, 50.5)
)
phase_colors <- c("Phase I" = "#8C1D40", "Phase II" = "#F2A93B",
                   "Phase III" = "#AEE1C8", "Phase IV" = "#3D7EB5")
phase_vlines <- c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5)
x_limits <- c(0, 51)

make_phase_strip <- function(layer_name) {
  ggplot(phase_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = Phase),
              color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = 0.5, label = Phase),
              size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phase_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = layer_name) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 0, 5.5),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
}

## =====================================================================
##  PANEL hzo / nirS -- escala sqrt (permite el 0), un solo eje
## =====================================================================
gene_colors_ab <- c("hzo" = "#7B3294", "nirS" = "#E08214")

make_ab_plot <- function(layer_name) {
  df <- genes_ab %>% filter(Layer == layer_name) %>%
    mutate(ymin = pmax(Mean - SE, 0), ymax = Mean + SE)
  all_days <- sort(unique(df$Day))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Day, y = Mean, color = Gene, group = Gene)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phase_vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), width = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors_ab) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "sqrt", name = "Gene copies (copies/mL)") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_days, labels = paste0("Day-", all_days), limits = x_limits) +
    labs(x = "Day", color = "Gene") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

p_ab_surface    <- make_ab_plot("Surface")
p_ab_subsurface <- make_ab_plot("Subsurface")

## =====================================================================
##  PANEL nifH (P8 / CR) -- escala log10; linea se corta en dias "no detectado"
## =====================================================================
gene_colors_nifH <- c("P8" = "#1B9E77", "CR" = "#D95F02")

make_nifH_plot <- function(layer_name) {
  floor_val <- 1  # piso de deteccion (1 copia L-1): representa "no detectado" en escala log10
  df <- genes_nifH %>%
    filter(Layer == layer_name) %>%
    arrange(Gene, Day) %>%
    mutate(
      Mean_plot = pmax(Mean, floor_val),            # los 0 bajan al piso -> el PUNTO se muestra ahi
      Mean_line = ifelse(Mean == 0, NA, Mean_plot),  # NA en el piso -> la LINEA se corta ahi
      ymin = pmax(Mean - SE, floor_val),
      ymax = pmax(Mean + SE, floor_val)
    )
  all_days <- sort(unique(genes_nifH$Day))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Day, color = Gene, group = Gene)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phase_vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Mean_line), linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Mean_plot), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), width = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors_nifH) +
    scale_y_log10(name = expression(italic("nifH")~"clusters (copies L"^-1*")")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_days, labels = paste0("Day-", all_days), limits = x_limits) +
    labs(x = "Day", color = "nifH cluster") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

p_nifH_surface    <- make_nifH_plot("Surface")
p_nifH_subsurface <- make_nifH_plot("Subsurface")

## =====================================================================
##  ENSAMBLAR: franja de fases (1 vez por columna) + hzo/nirS + nifH
## =====================================================================
strip_row <- make_phase_strip("Surface") | make_phase_strip("Subsurface")
ab_row    <- p_ab_surface   | p_ab_subsurface
nifH_row  <- p_nifH_surface | p_nifH_subsurface

genes_fig <- strip_row / ab_row / nifH_row +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.07, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))

genes_fig
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

## =====================================================================
##  1) CARGAR TODOS LOS DATOS
## =====================================================================
ipl_data  <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/combined_data_only_IPL.csv",
                         sep = ",", header = TRUE)
bac_data  <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/NMDS_mesocosms/merged_data_clean_M5_M6_ORDER_phases.csv",
                         sep = ",", header = TRUE)
rates     <- read.delim("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/Sebastian_Data/Rates.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE,
                         na.strings = c("NA", "NaN", "NAN", ""))
rates <- rates %>% mutate(N_Fix = pmax(N_Fix, 0, na.rm = FALSE))

kai_raw  <- read_excel("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/genes_data/Kai_qPCRs_amx_nirS.xlsx", sheet = 1)
susi_raw <- read_excel("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/genes_data/Susi_qPCR_data.xlsx", sheet = "Surf_Bott")

## =====================================================================
##  2) FASES (definicion unica, reutilizada por todo)
## =====================================================================
phase_df <- data.frame(
  Phase = factor(c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),
                 levels = c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV")),
  xmin  = c(0.5, 11.5, 19.5, 37.5),
  xmax  = c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5, 50.5)
)
phase_colors <- c("Phase I" = "#8C1D40", "Phase II" = "#F2A93B",
                   "Phase III" = "#AEE1C8", "Phase IV" = "#3D7EB5")
phase_vlines <- c(11.5, 19.5, 37.5)
x_limits <- c(0, 51)

make_phase_strip <- function(layer_name) {
  ggplot(phase_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = Phase),
              color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = 0.5, label = Phase),
              size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phase_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = layer_name) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 0, 5.5),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
}

## =====================================================================
##  3) RIQUEZA (Chao1) y DIVERSIDAD (Shannon) - IPL vs 16S
## =====================================================================
get_index_summary <- function(df, pattern, id_col, index_fun) {
  df %>%
    filter(grepl(pattern, .data[[id_col]])) %>%
    mutate(Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", .data[[id_col]]))) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), Day, where(is.numeric)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(Value = index_fun(c_across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Day$")))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(Value), SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
}
chao1_fun   <- function(x) estimateR(round(x))["S.chao1"]
shannon_fun <- function(x) diversity(x, index = "shannon")

rich_ipl_surface <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Surface", "X",  chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
rich_ipl_bottom  <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Bottom",  "X",  chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
rich_bac_surface <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Surface", "ID", chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")
rich_bac_bottom  <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Bottom",  "ID", chao1_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")

div_ipl_surface <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Surface", "X",  shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
div_ipl_bottom  <- get_index_summary(ipl_data, "^Bottom",  "X",  shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "Lipids (IPL)")
div_bac_surface <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Surface", "ID", shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")
div_bac_bottom  <- get_index_summary(bac_data, "^Bottom",  "ID", shannon_fun) %>% mutate(DataType = "16S rRNA")

palette_richness  <- c("Lipids (IPL)" = "#4393C3", "16S rRNA" = "#D6604D")
palette_diversity <- c("Lipids (IPL)" = "#2CA25F", "16S rRNA" = "#88419D")

## =====================================================================
##  4) TASAS DE NITROGENO
## =====================================================================
summarise_rate <- function(df, depth_name, value_col) {
  df %>%
    filter(Depth == depth_name, !is.na(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(.data[[value_col]]), SE = sd(.data[[value_col]]) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
}
nfix_surface        <- summarise_rate(rates, "Surface",    "N_Fix")
nfix_subsurface     <- summarise_rate(rates, "Subsurface", "N_Fix")
denit_subsurface    <- summarise_rate(rates, "Subsurface", "denitri_rate")
anammox_subsurface  <- summarise_rate(rates, "Subsurface", "anammox_rate")

process_colors <- c("Denitrification rate" = "#D7191C",
                     "Anammox rate"        = "#2166AC",
                     "N-Fixation rate"     = "#1B7837")

## =====================================================================
##  5) hzo / nirS  (M5-M8)
## =====================================================================
kai_clean <- kai_raw %>%
  rename(SampleID = `Sample ID`, hzo = `hzo [copies/mL]`, nirS = `nirs [copies/mL]`, Day = Day) %>%
  mutate(SampleID = str_trim(SampleID)) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(SampleID, "^PAC"), !str_detect(SampleID, "^DW")) %>%
  mutate(
    Mesocosm = as.numeric(str_extract(SampleID, "(?<=M-)\\d+")),
    Layer = ifelse(str_detect(SampleID, "Surf"), "Surface", "Subsurface")
  ) %>%
  filter(Mesocosm %in% 5:8)

genes_ab <- kai_clean %>%
  select(Day, Layer, hzo, nirS) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(hzo, nirS), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Day, Layer, Gene) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Value), SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

gene_colors_ab <- c("hzo" = "#7B3294", "nirS" = "#E08214")

## =====================================================================
##  6) nifH P8 / CR  (M5-M8)
## =====================================================================
measured_days_nifH <- c(2, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 24, 28, 32, 44, 48)

col_info <- tibble(col = names(susi_raw)) %>%
  filter(str_detect(col, "^(P8|CR) M\\d+ (S|B)\\s*$")) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = str_extract(col, "^(P8|CR)"),
    Mesocosm = as.numeric(str_extract(col, "(?<=M)\\d+")),
    Layer = ifelse(str_detect(col, " S\\s*$"), "Surface", "Subsurface")
  ) %>%
  filter(Mesocosm %in% 5:8)

nifH_long <- susi_raw %>%
  filter(day %in% measured_days_nifH) %>%
  select(Day = day, all_of(col_info$col)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Day, names_to = "col", values_to = "Value") %>%
  left_join(col_info, by = "col") %>%
  select(Day, Layer, Gene, Value)

genes_nifH <- nifH_long %>%
  group_by(Day, Layer, Gene) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), SE = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

gene_colors_nifH <- c("P8" = "#1B9E77", "CR" = "#D95F02")

## =====================================================================
##  7) DIAS MAESTROS: union de TODOS los dias de TODOS los datasets.
##     Se usa como 'breaks' fijo en CADA panel para que todas las filas
##     queden alineadas en posicion Y etiqueta.
## =====================================================================
all_days_master <- sort(unique(c(
  rich_ipl_surface$Day, rich_ipl_bottom$Day, rich_bac_surface$Day, rich_bac_bottom$Day,
  nfix_surface$Day, nfix_subsurface$Day, denit_subsurface$Day, anammox_subsurface$Day,
  genes_ab$Day, genes_nifH$Day
)))

shared_x_scale <- scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_days_master,
                                      labels = paste0("Day-", all_days_master),
                                      limits = x_limits)

## =====================================================================
##  8) FUNCIONES DE GRAFICO (todas usan shared_x_scale)
## =====================================================================
make_dual_plot <- function(ipl_df, bac_df, index_name, colors) {
  ipl_range <- range(c(ipl_df$Mean - ipl_df$SE, ipl_df$Mean + ipl_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  bac_range <- range(c(bac_df$Mean - bac_df$SE, bac_df$Mean + bac_df$SE), na.rm = TRUE)
  b <- diff(ipl_range) / diff(bac_range)
  a <- ipl_range[1] - b * bac_range[1]

  bac_df_scaled <- bac_df %>% mutate(Mean_s = a + b * Mean, SE_s = b * SE)
  plot_df <- bind_rows(ipl_df %>% mutate(Mean_s = Mean, SE_s = SE), bac_df_scaled) %>%
    mutate(DataType = factor(DataType, levels = c("Lipids (IPL)", "16S rRNA")))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Day, y = Mean_s, color = DataType, group = DataType)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phase_vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_s - SE_s, ymax = Mean_s + SE_s), width = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = paste0(index_name, " index (Lipids, IPL)"),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - a) / b, name = paste0(index_name, " index (16S rRNA)"))
    ) +
    shared_x_scale +
    labs(x = "Day", color = "Data type") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = colors[["Lipids (IPL)"]]),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = colors[["Lipids (IPL)"]]),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = colors[["16S rRNA"]]),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = colors[["16S rRNA"]]),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

p_rich_surface <- make_dual_plot(rich_ipl_surface, rich_bac_surface, "Chao1",   palette_richness)
p_rich_bottom  <- make_dual_plot(rich_ipl_bottom,  rich_bac_bottom,  "Chao1",   palette_richness)

  ) +

make_ab_plot <- function(layer_name) {
```
